analogy.rationale: PABA antagonists (sulfonamides) block bacterial folate synthesis and have no annotated human target; human cells do not synthesize folate de novo from PABA, so transcriptional response should be weak. The closest reference classes are other antifolate/antiinfective drugs that also lack a direct human target.
